title: Assessing the Performance of AI Models in Misinformation Detection Using Predefined Social Noise Constructs
abstract: arXiv:2610.17469v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Social media platforms generate vast volumes of user-generated content that often obscure meaningful discourse, a phenomenon conceptualized as social noise. While existing misinformation detection methods primarily focus on factual verification, they largely overlook the role of social noise in amplifying misinformation. This study assesses the performance of six text-based models and a graph neural network (GNN) in mitigating the effects of misinformation using predefined social noise constructs. The dataset consists of 500,000 tweets collected from the X platform using the Ukraine hashtag during the Russia-Ukraine conflict from March 2024 to March 2025. Advanced machine learning models achieve strong performance, with accuracies ranging from 79.94% to 97.17%. translated_title: 使用预定义社会噪声构念评估AI模型在虚假信息检测中的性能
translated_abstract: 社交媒体平台产生海量的用户生成内容，这些内容常常掩盖有意义的讨论，这种现象被概念化为“社会噪声”。现有的虚假信息检测方法主要侧重于事实核查，但在很大程度上忽视了社会噪声在放大虚假信息传播中所起的作用。本研究使用预定义的社会噪声构念，评估了六种基于文本的模型和一种图神经网络（GNN）在减轻虚假信息影响方面的性能。数据集由2024年3月至2025年3月俄乌冲突期间从X平台收集的、带有“乌克兰”话题标签的50万条推文组成。先进的机器学习模型表现出强劲的性能，准确率介于79.94%至97.17%之间。其中RoBERTa表现最佳，准确率达97.17%，Cohen's kappa为0.9660，MCC为0.9660，AUC为0.9977。GNN的准确率为64.52%，……
tldr: 本研究利用俄乌冲突期间的50万条推文和预定义的社会噪声构念，评估了六种文本模型与图神经网络在虚假信息检测中的表现，其中RoBERTa以97.17%的准确率表现最佳。
en_tdlr: This study assesses six text-based models and a GNN for misinformation detection using predefined social noise constructs on 500,000 Ukraine-conflict tweets, with RoBERTa achieving the best performance at 97.17% accuracy.
